name: Draxlr Embedded Analytics
tagline: Self-serve analytics in your SaaS, with row-level security
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Vivek, founder of Draxlr. Today we're launching the next step in our embedded analytics. You can now embed the complete Draxlr workspace inside your SaaS, not just individual dashboards. Embedded dashboards work well until customers start asking questions they weren't built for.
